visualReview.notes: Every standard frame inspected: asymmetric platform stairs, stepped podium/crown, four tall columns, eight engaged columns, opposed bull capitals, southern winged relief and inscription fields are intact.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Every shared frame inspected. Smooth metric marble now spans the monolithic fluted columns and sculpted capitals without inappropriate brick joints. The independent basalt relief strokes retain contrast, and the stair/podium edges remain crisp.

geographicReview.notes: The exact mapped stair/platform outline agrees with the orthographic render, including the wider western flight and slight upper chamber offset. The southern relief direction and anchor are preserved. Published 18 m total height is retained; the current roughly 10 m upper chamber follows current map parts and photographs, with the conflicting 16 m historical description retained in source limitations.

fidelityReview.notes: Passed for the complete current polygonal exterior reconstruction: mapped stepped construction and published height, fluted orders, bull capitals, winged relief, moldings and carved inscription fields are present. Sculpture and letter-like relief marks are original geometric representations; they do not claim readable Persian transcription or casts of the artworks.
